mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_api_key (key_value, key_name, device_id, permissions, status, rate_limit, last_used_at, expired_at, created_at) VALUES (#{keyValue}, #{keyName}, #{deviceId}, #{permissions}, #{status}, #{rateLimit}, #{lastUsedAt}, #{expiredAt}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, key_value, key_name, device_id, permissions, status, rate_limit, last_used_at, expired_at, created_at, revoked_at FROM t_api_key ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_api_key SET last_used_at = #{lastUsedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_api_key SET status = 'REVOKED', revoked_at = #{revokedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
